item.title: In Southern California, five rival supercolonies of Argentine ants are engaged in a war that has led to 15 million deaths already
item.description: A tumultuous and deadly rivalry unfolds among five Argentine ant supercolonies in San Diego, resulting in an alarming number of fatalities. Surprisingly, studies reveal that these colonies have reached an impasse, maintaining fixed borders even amid continuous aggression, indicating a lengthy conflict without an end in sight.
